title: Field Layout Tool
description: A GPS-powered tablet app for agricultural pivot planning — entirely in the field, not at a desk.

hero.headline: A GPS-powered tablet app for agricultural pivot planning.

paragraphs: The Field Layout Tool is a professional-grade iPad application for agricultural dealers who plan and install center-pivot irrigation systems — entirely in the field, not at a desk.

Before this app, dealers depended on a legacy desktop tool that required them to be at a computer, offered no GPS precision, and had no elevation awareness. This project replaced that workflow entirely with a connected, GPS-accurate, field-first experience.

phases.title: Legacy Audit
phases.description: Deeply studied the existing desktop application — documented every screen, every user action, every pain point. Mapped the old workflow step by step.

phases.title: User Flow Mapping
phases.description: Used FigJam to map the complete new user journey — from syncing a project, through GPS drawing and navigation, to syncing data back to the desktop.

phases.title: Design System
phases.description: Built a full design system following Valley brand guidelines — tablet-first, outdoor-use conditions: large touch targets, high contrast, clear hierarchy.

phases.title: Feature Design
phases.description: Each core feature designed with its full range of states: empty, loading, active, success, error, and edge cases. Nothing was left undocumented.

phases.title: Developer Handoff
phases.description: Restructured the final Figma file from the ground up for developer clarity — named layers, organized components, annotated interactions, 50+ screens.

applications.heading: Key Design Decisions
applications.description: Every decision was filtered through one reality: a dealer standing in a large field, in direct sunlight, wearing gloves.

apps.name: Oversized Vertex Handles
apps.subtitle: 44pt minimum touch targets for gloved-hand, outdoor use

keyChanges.before: Standard 24pt touch targets become unusable in gloved-hand, direct-sunlight conditions
keyChanges.after: All interactive map elements use a minimum 44pt touch target — significantly larger than convention

apps.name: Yellow Navigation Line
apps.subtitle: Maximum contrast against all terrain types in direct sunlight

keyChanges.before: Valley blue navigation line blends into sky-tone satellite imagery
keyChanges.after: Bright yellow (#F2C94C) provides maximum contrast against green fields, brown soil, grey roads — visible in direct sunlight

keyChanges.before: Numeric countdown during navigation requires focused reading
keyChanges.after: Full-width Red → Green gradient bar lets a dealer look up and know instantly how close they are

apps.name: Vertex Offset — Precision Input
apps.subtitle: GPS-accurate repositioning without physical drag error

keyChanges.before: A 5mm drag error on a tablet screen represents 20–50 feet of misalignment in the field
keyChanges.after: Dealers input exact angle + distance — GPS-accurate repositioning without physical drag error

apps.name: Full-Screen Sync Confirmation
apps.subtitle: Impossible to miss before closing the app

keyChanges.before: Small toast notification — easy to miss after uploading irreplaceable field data in remote locations
keyChanges.after: Large centered green checkmark — impossible to miss before closing the app, critical for unreliable rural connectivity

apps.name: Dual Progress Indicators
apps.subtitle: Both percentage and item count shown simultaneously

keyChanges.before: Single percentage progress leaves dealers guessing about total items
keyChanges.after: Both percentage (57%) and item count (14/28) shown simultaneously — quick gestalt plus precise tracking over slow rural connections

outcome.quote: The result is an app that looks simple — because the complexity was absorbed into the design. The dealer experience is clean, direct, and confidence-inspiring.

deliverables.title: GPS Accuracy
deliverables.description: GPS-accurate field surveys replaced imprecise desktop point placement — eliminating the guesswork that drove costly on-site errors.

deliverables.title: Elevation Intelligence
deliverables.description: Real-time elevation data introduced for the first time in the dealer workflow — enabling accurate slope-sensitive pivot engineering from the field.

deliverables.title: Connected Pipeline
deliverables.description: Sync pipeline connects tablet field data directly to desktop engineering calculations — zero manual re-entry, zero transcription errors.

deliverables.title: In Production
deliverables.description: 50+ screens delivered, full design system production-ready, and the Navigation tool eliminated the need for separate GPS devices on field visits.
